topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: The house felt oddly quiet, the usual chatter and clatter of preparation notably absent. I wandered from room to room, each empty and still. The kitchen, where laughter usually bubbled over pots and pans, held only the echo of silence. I checked the clock, the time felt wrong, like the sun had misjudged its setting. Outside, the street was empty, no glimpse of neighbors sneaking glances or cars parked out of sight. My stomach, expecting a flurry of activity and the warmth of gathered friends, now felt a hollow emptiness. I reached for my phone, the usual flurry of excited texts non-existent. The plans, so vivid just hours before, now seemed like a forgotten dream.
